description: Source code for passive entropy collection in BoringSSL, including platform-specific code for Android to retrieve entropy from a daemon, and functions for handling entropy requests in FIPS mode.

methods.name: get_seed_from_daemon
methods.description: Retrieves entropy seed from a Unix socket daemon on Android; returns 1 on success, 0 on failure.

methods.name: RAND_need_entropy
methods.description: Handles entropy requests in FIPS mode, attempting to gather entropy from a daemon or fallback.
